title: Farstrand - Kell, a dirge
message:
FARSTRAND boss theme "Kell", a dirge: his march slowed to a funeral.
D Phrygian, 100 BPM. Orders 1-4 loop.
KELL (the Survey's call turned inside out) stretched two to one, low and on bells; the Eb grinding on a D drone.
All samples synthesized. Source: songs/farstrand_boss_kell_dirge.gen.js
